spans.s: kḷpta (CII 3, 4; HRS), cf. sa-kḷpt-opakḷpta (IE 8-5); probably, the tax on permanent tenants or the fixed revenue; fixed tax which is one of the seven sources of revenue specified in the Arthaśāstra; cf. upakḷpta, kḷpta-kara, udraṅga, kḷpta-śluka, etc.
kḷpta-kara (IE 8-5), fixed tax; same as kḷpta-śulka; cf. sa-kḷpt-opakḷpta.
kḷpta-śulka (IE 8-5), fixed duty; same as kḷpta, kḷpta-kara; cf. sa-kḷpt-opakḷpta.
